'''Goroth Planetary Police armor''' was the [[Armor/Legends|armor]] used by the [[Goroth Planetary Police]]. It served a similar purpose to [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|stormtrooper armor]], although it was very different in appearance. The armor had eighteen pieces of armor with flat planes and intersecting angles and was colored blood red.

The suit's backpack contained an enhanced "scrubber/rebreather" capable of giving the wearer life support for up to ten [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]]. The [[heating unit]], powered by [[dylinium hydride]] [[Power cell/Legends|power packs]], could keep the wearer comfortable in temperature ranges from -75 degrees up to 170 degrees Celsius.

The armor had an integrated multi-band [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] with a range of 2 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]], enhancing targeting optics, and a [[Multi-Frequency Targeting and Acquisition System/Legends|Multi-Frequency Targeting and Acquisition System]].
